title: Analytics module settings
description: Operator settings of the analytics module.

admin_email.description: Login of the first GoatCounter user; defaults to admin@<company domain>. Used once, when the site is created.

x-can.handled: the chart, when the site is first created

site_domain.description: Domain of the tracked site; defaults to the company domain.

x-can.not_applied: the tracked site is the module's own host
it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it
